question: Which country unveiled the world's first floating nuclear power station?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Russia**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Russia** unveiled the world's first floating nuclear power station.
 
• The floating nuclear power station is named **Akademik Lomonosov**.
 
• It is designed to provide electricity to remote areas of Russia.
 
• The plant can generate enough electricity to power a town of 100,000 people.
 
• It is intended to supply power to areas where it is difficult to construct traditional power plants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Akademik Lomonosov** was constructed by the state nuclear power corporation, **Rosatom**.
 
• The power station is intended to replace aging nuclear plants and to supply power to remote mining operations.
 
• It marks a significant advancement in the use of nuclear energy for non-traditional applications.
 
• The floating nature of the plant allows it to be relocated as needed, providing flexibility in power distribution.
 
• Russia plans to construct more floating nuclear power stations to enhance its energy infrastructure.
